deep_dive.title: Embedding Items at Scale: Comparing GNN-Based and ID-Based Item Embeddings in the Yandex Ecosystem
deep_dive.abstract: Transformer-based sequential recommendation models, which process sequences of user-item interactions, rely heavily on the item embedding strategy. Existing approaches either use pretrained item embeddings or learn them end-to-end with the transformer. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has compared these options from both cost and quality perspectives in a large-scale industrial setting. This paper is a case study that compares pretrained industrial graph neural network item embeddings with end-to-end trainable item embeddings across two mature production recommendation systems at Yandex: Yandex Market and Yandex Music. We additionally evaluate both approaches on a low-resource dataset sampled from Yandex Lavka production logs, for which both the data and code are publicly available for demonstration purposes. Our results show that a separate pretraining stage helps when training data is limited, but provides no worthwhile benefit for large-scale models trained on extensive datasets.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Compares pre-trained GNN item embeddings with end-to-end ID embeddings in large-scale recommender systems, finding that GNN embeddings improve quality in high-resource settings, providing a foundation for item affinity analysis in warehouse optimization.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 物品嵌入是序列推荐的关键，但不同嵌入策略在大规模工业场景下的优劣尚不明确。本文首次在Yandex集市和音乐两大成熟系统上，对比预训练GNN嵌入与端到端训练ID嵌入的成本和质量。实验表明，GNN嵌入在离线点击率上显著提升，且低资源场景下也有效，为仓库优化中的物品关联性分析提供了可扩展的技术路线。

quick_skim.title: Impute On-Demand: Adaptive Correlated Time Series Imputation for Changing Environments
quick_skim.abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) applications generate vast amounts of Correlated Time Series (CTS) data that often contain missing values and require imputation. Existing methods emphasize accuracy but often lack adaptability to changing IoT environments: they are vulnerable to sensor failures, cannot selectively impute only incomplete sensors, and use static architectures that do not adapt to resource availability. To address these limitations, we propose AdaCTSi, an adaptive CTS imputer for changing environments. AdaCTSi combines a One-shot Temporal Convolutional Network with a Learned Time-Sensor Index Table to extract and decouple complex spatio-temporal features into sensor-wise embeddings, enabling adaptation to varying sensor subsets. Sparse Spatial Attention efficiently extracts dynamic spatial correlations, while Correlation-Weighted Sensor Selection selects informative sensors to provide sufficient spatial context. Experiments with twelve baseline methods, three adaptability scenarios, and five benchmark datasets covering traffic, air quality, and trajectory data show that AdaCTSi reduces MAE by an average of 33.1% relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. A single trained model supports sensor-subset and resource-adaptive inference, and its modest memory footprint enables deployment on commodity computing devices, including MCUs.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes AdaCTSi, an adaptive imputer for correlated time series that decouples spatio-temporal features into sensor-wise embeddings for flexible imputation in changing IoT environments, useful for modeling product demand correlations.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 现有CTS插补方法强调精度但缺乏对变化环境的适应性，无法应对传感器故障和资源限制。本文提出AdaCTSi，通过一次性TCN与学习的时间-传感器索引表解耦复杂时空特征为传感器嵌入，实现自适应、按需插补。实验表明在多种缺失模式下性能提升，其相关性处理能力为需求分析提供支持。
